data.summary: Asks of type question have an empty verb, and every approvals surface filters on verb: approvals_show, approvals_ask, harness attest and approvals_answer return 'no approval request', waiting_for_a_person (approvals pending, brief) skips them, and the MCP withdraw route (_own via approvals_list) is expected to refuse them too. engine.answer accepts free text but only direct callers reach it, and the digest source row's command `ddflow approvals show <id>` fails for its own kind. Found by reading ddflow/api/approvals.py, approvals_answer.py, approvals_harness.py, services/approvals/view.py and harness.py; not reproduced end to end.
data.title: A question ask has no surface a person can read or answer it through

data.summary: `ddflow next --phase P-swarm` printed '17 blocked' and then 10 rows with no 'more' line, while --json held all 17. SW-lead-link was among the rows left out, so the text form cannot answer whether an item is blocked, the check the coordinator asked for. Reproduced 2026-11-05.
data.title: `ddflow next` text lists 10 of 17 blocked items and does not say the rest were cut

data.body:
Fixes bug B-next-text-cuts-blocked-silently: `ddflow next --phase P-swarm` printed '17 blocked' and then 10 rows with no 'more' line, while --json held all 17. SW-lead-link was among the rows left out, so the text form cannot answer whether an item is blocked, the check the coordinator asked for. Reproduced 2026-11-05. Found on SW-lead-link.
